items.title: chore: add `FUNDING.yml`
items.body:
Following up on the query at https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/issues/13435#issuecomment-19496866, this PR suggests a simple [`FUNDING.yml`](https://forgejo.org/docs/latest/user/repository/funding/) file that links Forgejo's Liberapay profile at https://liberapay.com/forgejo.

Separately, I don't see this profile linked in the Forgejo project's README file. Should we also link that there?

Ref: Codeberg/.profile#3

items.title: fix: prevent git push --mirror from hitting errors on force-push pin refs
items.body:
Noted by @oliverpool in https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/15162#issuecomment-27459261.  The same approach as #14885 is used to allow the refs to be pushed by a `git push --mirror`, but the updates are discarded.  Both deletions and updates are ignored.

### Compliance

- [x] I confirm that I make this contribution in accordance with [Forgejo's AI Agreement](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/governance/src/commit/9084720dc6a7fbf1d3f358919d46bd6adfb55287/AIAgreement.md).

### Tests for Go changes

- I added test coverage for Go changes...
  - [ ] in their respective `*_test.go` for unit tests.
  - [x] in the `tests/integration` directory if it involves interactions with a live Forgejo server.
- I ran...
  - [x] `make pr-go` before pushing

### Documentation

- [ ] I created a pull request [to the documentation](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/docs) to explain to Forgejo users how to use this change.
- [x] I did not document these changes and I do not expect someone else to do it.

### Release notes

- [ ] This change will be noticed by a Forgejo user or admin (feature, bug fix, performance, etc.). I suggest to include a release note for this change.
- [x] This change is not visible to a Forgejo user or admin (refactor, dependency upgrade, etc.). I think there is no need to add a release note for this change.
    - Behaviour change in #15162, which is not released.
